fusions.name: Many-Armed Clinch
fusions.desc: Grabs every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 11 damage and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Reaching Coil
fusions.desc: Lashes a coiled arm out to 5 tiles, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.25 times as much at full reach. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Jetting Retreat
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds, and you finish the cast 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Every Arm Busy
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and your armour rises by 8%.
